title: DNS Resolution Failure in Zscaler Client Connector for Android on ChromeOS version 1.12

blocks.text: In Zscaler Client Connector for Android on ChromeOS version 1.12, users switching from LTE to Wi-Fi are experiencing DNS resolution failure while Zscaler Client Connector is running. This is a known issue due to Google’s upgrade to ChromeOS version 111 and will be fixed in ChromeOS version 114.
